reported_record.source_boundary: PDG correspondence only; SU(3) notation is not a formal SFT premise

reported_record.uncertainty_policy: PDG bracketed total uncertainty, the quadrature of reported statistical and systematic components
reported_record.quark_mass_status: renormalization-scheme-and-scale-dependent inferred parameters, not directly observed free-particle masses

nist_nucleon_masses.body: NIST / CODATA Task Group on Fundamental Constants

comparison_policy.composition: The sealed complete positive charge-word enumeration must return one three-member unit-positive word and one three-member empty-neutral word; PDG independently supplies the three-colour, qqq, colour-singlet correspondence.
comparison_policy.dominance: The SFT structural ledger predicts bare 1/128 below 1/100 and held 127/128 above 99/100. The complete PDG u,u,d current-mass interval divided by the complete NIST proton interval must independently remain below 1/100; its positive residual must remain above 99/100.
comparison_policy.nonconflation: No equality is asserted between exact structural 1/128 and the scheme-dependent PDG current-quark mass ratio. The registered empirical claim is the strict dominance class and complete ledger direction.
comparison_policy.ordering: The sealed exact down-over-up and net neutron-surplus signs must agree with the complete PDG light-quark intervals and the complete NIST neutron/proton mass-energy intervals. Every standard uncertainty is propagated outward with exact fractions.
comparison_policy.adverse_control: Any source revision making the uud current-mass upper fraction reach 1/100, reversing d/u ordering, or allowing proton and neutron intervals to overlap falsifies the registered comparison.
